# NULL Riser upstream

Source: https://github.com/koulaxizis/null-jsfx/tree/5a8ba8b304f948c88e0f71673811841c09d4a6f4

Copyright (c) 2026 Christos Koulaxizis. MIT; complete licence in LICENSE.md.
The original source files are retained unmodified. ML Riser is a Rust adaptation of RiserDSP.hpp / riser.jsfx, using ML's shared stock plugin UI. The seven intensity presets retain their upstream names and values, plus Default (0%). No external JSFX, DPF or REAPER runtime is needed. Processing uses double states, the same block-rate coefficients, Park-Miller noise, 30 ms smoothing and cross-fed delays. Explicit host reset clears all filters, delay state and the random seed. Non-finite input is replaced by silence.

Intensity 0% settles to exact dry audio; other settings generate noise even on silent input. This is an effect to automate, not a self-running musical sequence. Settings > Visibility > Stock plugins > Advanced DSP controls hides its control panel without changing audio or saved data.

reference.csv is generated by compiling reference.cpp against this unchanged RiserDSP.hpp with clang++ -O2 -std=c++17 and capturing stdout. Tests compare 2,880 stereo sample pairs over 8, 48 and 192 kHz, including intensity changes, feedback delays and return to dry.
